name: STRICT_FIVE_TYPES_TYPEOF
description: STRICT table allows INT, INTEGER, REAL, TEXT, BLOB, ANY; typeof matches per stored value

name: STRICT_INT_ACCEPTS_INT_LITERAL
description: STRICT INT column accepts integer literal and stores as integer

name: STRICT_INT_ACCEPTS_NUMERIC_TEXT
description: STRICT INT accepts numeric-looking text and coerces it to integer

name: STRICT_INT_ACCEPTS_WHOLE_REAL
description: STRICT INT accepts whole-number REAL and stores as integer

name: STRICT_INT_REJECTS_NON_WHOLE_REAL
description: STRICT INT rejects non-whole REAL value

name: STRICT_INT_REJECTS_NON_NUMERIC_TEXT
description: STRICT INT rejects non-numeric text

name: STRICT_INT_REJECTS_BLOB
description: STRICT INT rejects BLOB value

name: STRICT_REAL_COERCES_INTEGER
description: STRICT REAL accepts integer literal and coerces to REAL storage

name: STRICT_REAL_REJECTS_NON_NUMERIC_TEXT
description: STRICT REAL rejects non-numeric text

name: STRICT_REAL_REJECTS_BLOB
description: STRICT REAL rejects BLOB value

name: STRICT_TEXT_COERCES_INTEGER
description: STRICT TEXT accepts integer literal and stores it as TEXT

name: STRICT_TEXT_COERCES_REAL
description: STRICT TEXT accepts REAL literal and stores it as TEXT

name: STRICT_TEXT_REJECTS_BLOB
description: STRICT TEXT rejects BLOB value

name: STRICT_BLOB_ACCEPTS_BLOB
description: STRICT BLOB accepts blob literal and stores as BLOB

name: STRICT_BLOB_REJECTS_INTEGER
description: STRICT BLOB rejects integer value

name: STRICT_BLOB_REJECTS_TEXT
description: STRICT BLOB rejects text value

name: STRICT_ANY_PRESERVES_INPUT_TYPES
description: STRICT ANY column preserves the input storage class for each value (no affinity coercion)

name: STRICT_UNKNOWN_TYPE_REJECTED
description: STRICT table rejects non-allowed type name on CREATE
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
CREATE TABLE t(a VARCHAR) STRICT;

name: STRICT_NUMERIC_TYPE_REJECTED
description: STRICT table rejects NUMERIC type (not in the allowed five+ANY set)
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
CREATE TABLE t(a NUMERIC) STRICT;

name: STRICT_NULL_ALLOWED_BY_DEFAULT
description: STRICT columns accept NULL by default

name: STRICT_NOT_NULL_REJECTS_NULL
description: STRICT column with NOT NULL rejects NULL insert

name: STRICT_VALID_DEFAULT_APPLIED
description: STRICT DEFAULT of matching type is used when row omits the column

name: STRICT_MISMATCHED_DEFAULT_REJECTED_ON_INSERT
description: STRICT type-mismatched DEFAULT errors at INSERT-time (the default value is checked against the column type)

name: STRICT_CHECK_PASSING_AND_FAILING
description: STRICT column with CHECK constraint rejects out-of-range values

name: STRICT_INTEGER_PK_ALIAS
description: STRICT table with INTEGER PRIMARY KEY still acts as rowid alias

name: STRICT_WITHOUT_ROWID_COMBO
description: STRICT and WITHOUT ROWID compose; values keep declared types

name: STRICT_INSERT_SELECT_REJECTS_WRONG_TYPE
description: STRICT INSERT ... SELECT rejects when source row's value can't coerce to declared type

name: STRICT_TEXT_UPDATE_REJECTS_BLOB
description: STRICT type enforcement also applies on UPDATE (BLOB rejected for TEXT column)
